name: Griflet

attributes.attribute: early knight of the Round Table
the lover of Griflet, an enchantress or maiden

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Griflet, also called Jaufre, is an Arthurian hero. This young man stands among the earliest knights of the Round Table. He was the lover of Brunissen, an enchanted maiden. The source gives only this hint, so the full story stays short.

okr.objective: Note Griflet as an early Arthurian knight and the lover of Brunissen.
key_results: Griflet carries the other name Jaufre.
He ranks among the earliest knights of the Round Table.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore, 2003
